subtitle: Find out why the other bank went dark.
briefing: The landing lamp has gone out. Across the river, every window is dark. The ferry is tied up on the far bank, and nobody answers from the crossing. Take the island fords and find the ferryman.
hints: Find the scouts in the western woods to reinforce your patrol.

intro.text: That landing lamp has burned every night since I was a boy. Last night it went out. So did every window on the other bank.
Still tied up over there. We’ll have to take the fords round the island.
The wind’s coming down the valley. That mist is creeping the other way.
A whole winter at the Collegium. This wasn’t in the lessons.
Find the ferryman. Quickly. Whatever happened, he’s alone over there.

victory.text: Both lanterns are burning. Leave someone watching the crossing; the rest of us take the eastern road. We still have people to find.

debrief: The patrol reached the ferryman and secured the eastern villages.
